_comment: Copy this file as profile.json (next to the script) and change it. 'forbidden': ingredient ids that must never be used. 'everyone' applies to every dish; add one list per diner (the name you will put in each recipe's 'for'). 'targets': [minimum kcal, maximum kcal, minimum protein in g] per week type and meal. 'lunch_only': starches you do not want at dinner (potato, rice, pasta, pulses, bread, quinoa).
